forbidden: claiming state identity vs unsaved traces
interpretation: effect of the first substitution under S10 continuation only; does not explain all policy differences; null does not rule out later-decision effects
policy: greedy argmax-4 gate -> greedy viewed skill (S4 semantics); skills pristine obs+views
primary: intervention minus S10 arrival change per theta + mean, paired improve/worsen

rule.intervention: fresh env same seed; S10 actions until t, S11 primitive once at t, S10 after; full trace saved
rule.null: no executable-action difference in visited steps -> record null, keep episode with S10 outcome
rule.repro: S10 via run_ep-identical loop; verify cause/T/uses/switches vs s11_eval TSTU10; any mismatch halts everything
rule.rng: env noise stream from episode seed only; policies use no RNG (state asserted unchanged around policy calls); obs-prefix bit-match asserts same noise; no planner queries
rule.scan: during S10 trajectory compute S11 primitive on same obs; first t with a11!=a10 (skill-only diffs do not count); first skill-diff logged as secondary
